bayts.text: by the sūra al-Qiyāma, the venerated, and the sūra al-Insān, possessed of might,
al-Mursalāt and by the right of an-Nabaʾ and an-Nāziʿāt; and inform my heart.
O You Who held back and stayed harm toward others than me, bless with peace, by the sanctity of ʿAbasa,
the chosen, purified Prophet, Muḥammad, the best of creation, the purifier.
And lead to him, by the sūra at-Takwīr and al-Infiṭār, an increase of illumination,
in his Family and his Companions; and free me from innovations, through You and through the reviver of the sunnas.
O Kind (Al-Barr), O Accepter of repentance (At-Tawwāb), You are the Governor (Al-Wālī), the Self-Exalted (Al-Mutaʿālī), the One Who sets the states right,
bless with peace the best of creation, O You Who through him illumined the hearts of others than him,
his Family and his Companions; and lead to him, by the sūra al-Muṭaffifīn, his request.
And grant him, by al-Inshiqāq, al-Burūj and the sūra aṭ-Ṭāriq, what surpasses the ascension,
before the Resurrection; and guard his Book, O Bestower Who granted me writing.
By the sūra al-Aʿlā and by the right of al-Ghāshiya, bless with a blessing that never ceases to grow,
with a lasting peace that gives glad tidings, upon the chosen Prophet, the announced,
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome,
And spare me, O Lord, what You did not approve for me, before it makes (for me), by the preferred Prophet.
by the sūra al-Fajr and the sūra al-Balad, ash-Shams and al-Layl, and by the sanctity of the City (Mecca),
bless our master Muḥammad, his Family and his Companions, O my Eternal Refuge.
O You through Whom the punishments have made toward others than me, unto the Garden of eternity, O Avenger (Al-Muntaqim),
bless, grant peace and bless forever the one You named Muḥammad,
his Family and his Companions; and by aḍ-Ḍuḥā renew his way through me, making it clear.
By ash-Sharḥ, at-Tīn and the sūra al-ʿAlaq bless the opener of what was before closed,
our master Muḥammad, and grant peace, and the Family and the Companions; and preserve my pen.
O Pardoner (Al-ʿAfuww), O Kind (Ar-Raʾūf), bless forever and grant peace upon him whose precedence has appeared,
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome,
By the sūra al-Qadr and by the right of al-Bayyina bless the generous one whose loftiness is evident,
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome,
O Owner of dominion, by the right of az-Zalzala, bless him who led his hospitality to me,
without tremor, or wandering, or injustice; and You have already spared me fabricated words.
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome,
O Lord, Possessor of majesty and honour, bless with peace and with respect
the Prophet possessed of distinctions, Aḥmad, the Family and the Companions; and make this striving praiseworthy.
By al-ʿĀdiyāt and by the right of al-Qāriʿa bless the one possessed of precedence and swiftness,
our master Muḥammad, O Equitable (Al-Muqsiṭ), and the Family and the Companions who practised equity.
O Gatherer (Al-Jāmiʿ), O Rich (Al-Ghanī), You are the Enricher (Al-Mughnī): bless with peace him who is free of need
through You, with his Family and his noble Companions; and lead to him, with this poem, the best aim.
And by at-Takāthur and by the right of al-ʿAṣr bless him through whom You bestowed victory on me,
through him, without affliction or turbidity; and grant peace upon him, O You Who make the decree flow,
with his Family and his Companions, O Preventer (Al-Māniʿ), O Best of those whom a diligent servant has pleased.
O You to Whom belongs the active participle from "harm" (Aḍ-Ḍārr): You have already spared me its harm and peril.
bless with peace, by the right of al-Humaza, O You Who spared me it, and the word of backbiting,
the Prophet Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
O Giver of the light that never sets, bless with peace, by the right of al-Fīl,
the Prophet and Messenger Aḥmad, the Family and the Companions; and make my life praiseworthy.
By the right of what You sent down concerning Quraysh, as a sūra, bless the Qurayshite,
our master Muḥammad, and grant peace, and the Family and the Companions; and keep all of me safe
from all that grieves or harms, O All-Merciful, O Most Merciful, You are the Kind (Al-Barr).
O Light (An-Nūr), O Benefactor (An-Nāfiʿ), You are the Guide (Al-Hādī), O You Who already brought my struggle to its end,
bless with peace the best of creation, the Family and the Companions; and illumine all of me.
And grant me benefit in all things, with Your guidance, and grant me elevation.
O our Lord, by the sūra al-Māʿūn turn the harm of the Accursed toward others than me.
O our Lord, grant me, by the right of al-Kawthar, the blessing of life, and multiply my rewards.
O our Lord, turn the unbelievers toward others than me, without harm to me, by the right of al-Kāfirūn.
O Inheritor (Al-Wārith), O Originator (Al-Badīʿ), You are the Everlasting (Al-Bāqī); Yours are the seven earths, like the layers (of heaven).
bless with peace our master Muḥammad, our beloved, our guide,
his Family and his Companions; and make the letters of this poem, for good things, the best of vessels.
And make through him this poem like all good things, O You Who make provisions abide.
By the sūra an-Naṣr and Tabbat (al-Masad) hold back the hearts of the envious and the hands
toward a direction other than mine; and by al-Ikhlāṣ bestow on me, toward the Gardens, sincerity.
O Rightly-Guiding (Ar-Rashīd), O Patient (Aṣ-Ṣabūr), bless with peace him who uttered the finest speech,
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome,
And spare me, by the right of the sūra al-Falaq and the sūra an-Nās, harm, O You Who created.
And write for him — may He bless him with peace — in his Family and his Companions, the Everlasting, the Peace,
for every letter of these letters, a glad tiding by which my good may grow.
